scientific_guardrails: The four source labels describe different material classes and synthesis or procurement histories; they are not controlled levels of one process variable.
Cross-material feature differences are descriptive and confounded by material identity, synthesis route, preparation, and measurement sampling.
A common dataset package does not prove that every technique measured identical physical aliquots.
Only exact configured datafile IDs and filenames are accepted for this case.
TEM files are checksum-verified for readiness but quantitative segmentation is blocked because the current global threshold-region method is not validated across these morphologies and supports.
No process-response model, causal interpretation, prediction, optimization, phase confirmation, chemical-state assignment, or engineering-release claim is permitted.
